title: EP02. 해달 겨드랑이 속 '평생 쓰는 돌'?

narration: 해달한테 평생 쓰는 돌이 있다고요? 반은 틀렸어요!
scenes.title:
해달의 평생 돌?
**반은 틀렸어요**
scenes.motion: The otter turns the stone slowly in its paws and blinks in amazement. The red question mark bounces softly. Gentle waves.

scenes.title: **오늘의 궁금증**
scenes.motion: The otter bobs gently on the water, looks at the viewer with a curious smile and taps its notebook with the pencil. Sunlight glitters on the waves, the kelp in the corner sways softly.

narration: 해달 앞다리 아래엔 늘어진 피부 주머니가 있어요.
바다 밑에서 주운 조개랑 돌을 여기 넣고 올라와요.
scenes.title:
진짜예요:
**앞다리 아래 주머니**
scenes.motion: The otter lifts its front leg a little higher to show the pocket, the stone inside wiggles slightly, then it looks at the viewer proudly. Gentle waves.

narration: 물 위에 누워 배에 돌을 올리고,
마음에 드는 돌은 한동안 들고 다니기도 하고요.
scenes.title:
배 위에서 **탕탕!**
돌로 조개 깨기
scenes.motion: The otter taps the clam on the stone on its belly three times, small splashes rise, a piece of shell falls off. It bobs gently on the water.

narration: 그런데 평생 한 개만 쓴다는 건 과장이에요.
돌을 거의 안 쓰는 해달도 있거든요.
해달마다 도구 쓰는 정도가 아주 다르대요.
scenes.title:
평생 한 돌?
**과장이에요**
scenes.motion: The left otter taps a clam on its stone, the right otter nibbles the sea urchin, the small otter with the blue scarf tilts its head and writes in its notebook. Kelp sways slowly.

narration: 도구를 자주 쓰는 해달은 이빨이 덜 상했대요.
scenes.title:
도구 쓰면
**이빨이 덜 상해요**
scenes.motion: The otter smiles wider, a small sparkle flashes on its teeth, and it holds the stone up proudly. Gentle waves.

narration: 평생 돌 말고, 잘 맞는 돌!
scenes.title:
~~평생 쓰는 돌~~
**잘 맞는 돌**
scenes.motion: The otter draws a line across the notebook with its pencil, writes a new line underneath, then looks up with a proud smile. Gentle waves.

scenes.title:
다음 궁금증
**댓글로 알려주세요**
scenes.motion: The otter waves its paw at the viewer twice and smiles, bobbing softly on the water. Sunlight sparkles on the waves.

motion_suffix: Static camera, no zoom, no cuts. Gentle, natural, slow motion. Keep the character's appearance, light sky-blue scarf and tiny yellow notebook exactly the same as the first frame. No text, no new characters, no new objects. Vertical 9:16.
motion_negative: text, subtitles, extra limbs, extra otters, morphing face, camera shake, zoom
